title: Knobby Australian Tofu Hash
description: A funky, crumbly, brunch-mood Australian dish featuring marinated tofu, soffritto-base, served on a tagliere, jain-friendly
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the crumbled tofu to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Spread the marinated tofu on a baking sheet and bake for 20 minutes.
In a large skillet, heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion, grated carrot, and chopped celery to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the diced tomato to the skillet and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
To assemble the hash, place the baked tofu on a tagliere and top with the soffritto mixture.
Serve the Knobby Australian Tofu Hash hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
